Dark-mode toggle in Settings approved

People who read their notes at night want Pocket Notes in a dark theme, chosen once in Settings and kept.

The problem

A user opens Pocket Notes in bed to jot down tomorrow's list. The room is dark, the phone is dimmed, and the app fills the screen with white. They squint, type two lines, and close it.

Pocket Notes has one theme, and it is light. There is no way to change it, and it ignores the device's dark setting. People who write at night find it uncomfortable, and some have stopped using it after dark.

Who it affects

Everyone who uses Pocket Notes in low light, on phone or desktop. Most use their phone. Many already run their device in dark mode and expect apps to follow it.

Today / Wanted

Today

Settings has no appearance row. Every page is light.

Wanted

A person can pick how the app looks in Settings. The app changes at once, keeps the choice, and opens in that theme next time without a flash of white.

Success

  1. SC-1 A person can choose System, Light or Dark in Settings, and the app changes at once.
  2. SC-2 The choice is still in effect after a reload or a new visit on the same device.
  3. SC-3 Pages open in the chosen theme from the first frame, with no flash of the other one.

Appetite

One pull request, about a day of work, including QA in both themes.

Constraints

  • Colours come from the existing tokens in src/styles/tokens.css; dark gets its own values for the same semantic names.
  • No new dependencies.
  • Text keeps at least 4.5:1 contrast in both themes.

Non-goals

  • Syncing the choice across devices or to the account.
  • Custom accent colours or more themes.
  • Restyling any screen beyond giving it dark values.

Unknowns

None open. [ASSUMPTION: storing the choice per device is enough for now, since nobody asked for sync.] The storage question was settled as D-2.

Open decisions

Both decisions this brief named are settled:

  • The shape of the control in Settings: settled as D-1 (three-way segmented control).
  • Where the choice is stored: settled as D-2 (browser storage on the device).

Evidence

  • Known: Settings has no appearance option (screenshot).
  • Known: the stylesheet already uses semantic colour tokens, so dark values can be added in one place.
  • Suspected: most night-time sessions are on phones. Not measured.

Sources

  • The app's Settings screen and stylesheet at the starting commit.
  • The product feedback request for a dark theme.
